item.title: Flo To Take-On Walking Challenge for Oxendon House Care Home
item.description: Eight-year-old Flo Wright is raising money for Oxendon House care home in Great Oxendon with a walking challenge in the Peak District. Flo is a regular visitor to the residents during weekends and school holidays, helping with activities like dominoes, art, reading — and her favourite, baking. She even helped wrap the residents’ Christmas presents. […]

item.title: Celebrations After SEND Nursery Closure Plans Scrapped
item.description: Campaigners are celebrating after Leicestershire County Council abandoned plans to close four specialist nurseries for children with special educational needs and disabilities (SEND). The proposal had suggested moving SEND provision into mainstream nurseries, but many parents feared their children would be placed in settings not properly equipped to meet their needs. item.title: Water Supply Disruption Hits Hundreds of Homes
item.description: Hundreds of homes and businesses near Market Harborough have no water or very low pressure following a pump failure. item.title: Leicestershire Records Wettest Winter On Record
item.description: Leicestershire has experienced its wettest winter on record according to provisional figures from the Met Office. The county is one of three areas in England that saw record-breaking rainfall between December and February.
